Employee Management System - Requirements Document
1. Project Overview
The Employee Management System (EMS) is a centralized platform designed to manage employee
information efficiently within an organization. It provides functionality for HR/admin to add, update, and delete
employee data, while enabling employees to view and manage their profiles. The system also handles
departments, roles, attendance, and performance tracking.
2. Objectives
- Maintain accurate employee records
- Streamline HR processes (onboarding, offboarding, promotions)
- Track attendance, leaves, and performance
- Generate reports for analysis and compliance
3. Scope
This EMS will include:
- Employee data management
- Department and role allocation
- Attendance and leave tracking
- Performance and appraisal tracking
- Admin and employee portals with appropriate access control
4.

Stakeholders
- Admin (HR / Management): Full access to all modules
- Employee: Limited access to personal data and related modules
- IT Support: For system maintenance
5. System Features & Functional Requirements
5.1 User Authentication & Authorization:
- Login/Logout functionality
Employee Management System - Requirements Document
- Role-based access (Admin, Employee)
5.2 Employee Management:
- Add/Edit/Delete employee details
- Assign department, role, manager
- View employee directory
5.3 Department & Role Management:
- Create/Edit/Delete departments
- Assign roles to users
- Map reporting hierarchy
5.4 Attendance & Leave Management:
- Mark daily attendance (in-time/out-time)
- Apply for leaves
- Approve/reject leaves (admin)
5.5 Performance & Appraisal:
- Record employee performance reviews
- Assign goals/targets
- View appraisal history
5.6 Notifications & Reminders:
- Leave approval alerts
- Birthday/work anniversary reminders
- System announcements
5.

7 Reports & Analytics:
- Attendance reports
- Department-wise employee reports

- Performance summaries
6. Non-Functional Requirements
- Security: Secure login, encrypted sensitive data
- Scalability: Support for growing number of employees
- Availability: 99.9% uptime
- Usability: Intuitive UI with responsive design
- Performance: Fast CRUD operations (<1s response time)
7. Technology Stack (Suggested)
- Frontend: React.js / Angular
- Backend: Node.js / Django / Flask
- Database: PostgreSQL / MySQL
- Authentication: JWT / OAuth 2.0
- Hosting: AWS / Azure / On-premise
8. Assumptions
- All employees have unique employee IDs
- Admin will onboard initial data
- Internet access is available to all users
9. Constraints
- System should comply with local labor laws (data privacy, etc.)
- Must support export to CSV/PDF for reports
